front.title: Benchmarking Terminology for AI Agent Security Evaluation

abstract.t: This document defines terminology for the security evaluation of AI agents. It establishes a shared vocabulary for four first-level evaluation dimensions -- Foundation Model Security, Interaction Security, Operational Security, and Basic Security -- for the 55 second-level evaluation metrics organized under those dimensions, for the common metric evaluation convention that applies to all of them, and for the three agent security risk levels. This document defines terminology only. It does not prescribe evaluation procedures; the procedures are specified in [I-D.han-bpm-agent-security-benchmark-methodology], and the System Under Test boundaries and evaluation scenarios are specified in [I-D.han-bpm-agent-security-benchmark-profiles].
